summary: The image exhibits multiple forensic indicators consistent with AI generation, including unnatural skin texture uniformity and subtle inconsistencies in facial lighting. The presence of a watermark referencing StyleGAN2 strongly suggests synthetic origin.

signals.name: "StyleGAN2" watermark
signals.technical_description: The image contains a visible watermark in the bottom right corner reading 'StyleGAN2 (Karras et al.)', which directly identifies it as output from a known generative adversarial network model. This is definitive evidence of AI generation.

signals.name: Skin texture uniformity
signals.technical_description: The skin exhibits unnaturally smooth and uniform texture with minimal pore structure or natural imperfections, particularly around the cheeks and forehead. This lack of micro-detail is characteristic of GAN-generated faces.

signals.name: Lighting consistency
signals.technical_description: "The lighting on the face appears slightly inconsistent, with subtle mismatches in shadow direction between the nose and cheek areas. While not definitive alone, this contributes to an overall synthetic appearance when combined with other signals.

signals.name: Hair strand definition
signals.severity: "The hair strands show some unnatural clustering and lack fine individual detail, especially near the edges of the face. This is a common artifact in GAN-generated portraits where hair rendering remains challenging.
